finding: The streamed candidate path (--stream-candidate-features, stream_vlad_globals_from_feature_files) already implements the intended two-pass descriptor streaming: a row-count prepass fixes the global stride, a second pass collects the bounded training sample, and a third pass aggregates one image's VLAD at a time under rayon. It never retains the local descriptor bank. It was validated to produce a byte-identical candidate manifest to the batch path at every tier while cutting candidate peak RSS by ~3.3-4x.

implementation.batch: candidate_pairs_vlad_scored loads every FeatureSet into a Vec<FeatureSet> (the descriptor bank), then computes globals and the exact top-k.
implementation.streamed: stream_vlad_globals_from_feature_files streams feature files; only one FeatureSet per rayon worker plus the N x D globals are resident.
implementation.runner: scripts/benchmark_electro.py exposes --stream-candidate-features (build_candidate_command); LSH retrieval already requires it.
implementation.history: streamed path added in acaef39 'perf(sfm): stream descriptors with scale-aware ANN retrieval'.

measurements.command: unordered_sfm_demo --pair-source temporal-pyramid --retrieval-topk 32 --temporal-pyramid-max-offset 32 --candidate-budget <7N> (--stream-candidate-features for the streamed arm)

decision: Adopt --stream-candidate-features as the connected-run candidate policy: byte-identical output, ~3.3x lower candidate-phase peak RSS at 10k (1.15 GiB -> 354 MiB), and equal-or-better wall. The batch path remains the default for callers without a calibration root (streaming requires --input-colmap-calibration).
